output: github_document
date: "2026-11-23"
---

```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

Loading in data:
* Cleaning names
* Cutting it down to only bus and subway modes of transportation
* Filtering to January through October 2025 and 2026

```{r}
ridership_df = 
  read_csv("data/MTA_Daily_Ridership_and_Traffic.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date  = mdy(date),
    count = parse_number(as.character(count))
  ) |>
  filter(
    mode %in% c("Bus", "Subway"),
    year(date) %in% c(2025, 2026),
    month(date) <= 10
  )
```
